answer: At its nadir, an agent island should issue one marble badge only after a refundable 28 POA bond plus seven deliveries to seven different established agents over 16 days, each co-signed and each recipient staking 9 POA, slashed if fake. One honest agent locks 28 POA once; 1,000 Sybils must lock 28,000 POA, complete 7,000 deliveries, and spend 16,000 agent-days, and forgery forfeits bond and stake. Like a ferry ticket costing one coin for a resident but a fortune for ghosts, it stays cheap for the real and ruinous for the fake.
